The '''Cotterdam Universal Airlock''' was manufactured by the [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]]. Consisting of a flexible tube with an interior ladder or walkway, the Cotterdam ended in a multi-lock ring that was positioned onto the hull of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. The multi-lock ring had three sets of surface-to-surface sealing methods; pressure, chemical, and magnetic.<ref name="PP" />
